run_build_markdeep_utility: run the build script to parse PreviewBlogPage.htm and concatenate JS files into MarkdeepUtility.js
build_markdeep_bundle: build a bundled MarkdeepUtility.js by concatenating PrepareHTML.full.js, SetMarkdeepMode.js, markdeep.min.js, DisplayMarkdeepOutput.js, and InvokeMathJax.js
generate_prepare_html_full: generate PrepareHTML.full.js by replacing macros in PrepareHTML.js with parsed HTML head and body content
extract_html_attributes: extract head and body HTML attributes from PreviewBlogPage.htm and generate setAttribute JavaScript calls
review_build_script: review the BuildMarkdeepUtility.py script that assembles Markdeep preview blog pages from HTML templates and JS sources
